messages:
jordan: FYI customer (acme-inc) flagged a big delta between invoice tokens and dashboard served_tokens after we enabled continuous batching + KV prefetch last Wed. Invoice shows ~4.2M, dashboard ~2.1M. They think they're being double-billed.

olivia: Thanks — can you paste a sample request id / trace id and the deploy config you flipped? Also which region?

jordan: region: us-west-2. trace ids: trace_8a2f, trace_8a33, trace_8a97 (from their app logs). Deploy config snippet they used: 
```
serving:
  batching:
    mode: continuous
    window_ms: 40
  prefetch:
    enabled: true
    ttl_s: 60
```
They also added header: `x-redwood-prefetch: true` in their proxy for testing.

mike: quick note — our metering records internal prefetch requests as billable by default (they hit the model and consume tokens). Dashboard's `served_tokens` currently only shows tokens attributed to completed user-facing responses, so prefetch can create a delta. That sounds like what you're seeing.

tara: to add, continuous batching + prefetch can cause warmups that are executed ahead of the real request; those warmup calls generate KV cache and consume tokens even if later the cached KV reduces generation for user request. So billed_tokens >= served_tokens in that case.

olivia: Can you run this query against billing events and share the output?
```sql
SELECT event_ts, event_type, trace_id, tokens
FROM billing.events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-inc'
  AND event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-17'
  AND event_type IN ('model_call', 'prefetch')
ORDER BY event_ts;
```

jordan: Running now, returning a lot of `prefetch` rows tied to those trace ids. Looks like prefetch calls are clustered ~10–50ms before the user model call.

sam: Billing perspective — invoices include all metered model calls (including internal prefetch) unless flagged otherwise. We do have a flag on some enterprise contracts to exclude prefetch-type events, but not broadly. For acme-inc contract: none of those exclusions apply.

olivia: OK. Customer expects dashboard == invoice; that's a product expectation mismatch. We should surface prefetch tokens in the console and label them in the invoice line items. Immediate ask: can we confirm how many tokens were prefetch vs user-facing for the week so we can propose a credit?

mike: I can get a breakdown. Run this diagnostic on metering service: 
```bash
redwoodctl metering query \
  --customer acme-inc \
  --from 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z \
  --to   2026-03-17T23:59:59Z \
  --group-by event_type \
  --filter "event_type:prefetch,model_call"
```
That will return token sums per event_type. Expect `prefetch` to be roughly the difference. Also check `internal_slot_id` — continuous batching can run multiple warmups for separate batch slots which multiplies prefetch invocations.

tara: root cause for duplication: we were conservative about cache safety and currently prefetch warms per slot + per predicted next-prefix. For high concurrency that scales linearly. Short term mitigation: reduce prefetch ttl or disable prefetch for the tenant. Long term: dedupe warmups by prefix & slot or mark warmups with an internal tenant flag that metering can optionally exclude.

sam: For this customer I propose: 1) run the metering query and confirm numbers, 2) issue a one-time credit equal to the `prefetch` tokens this week while we update docs and console, 3) offer to flip off prefetch on their deploy until we ship better visibility. Approving credit needs an ops ticket.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-907: credit review requested for customer acme-inc (linked traces: trace_8a2f, trace_8a33, trace_8a97) :ticket:.

olivia: Jordan — can you confirm whether acme-inc wants prefetch disabled immediately or they'd prefer a quick config change window?

jordan: They asked to keep feature on for now but want credit for the week and clearer billing lines.

mike: Action items I will pick up: 
- run `redwoodctl` query and paste numbers here (ETA: 2h)
- add a temporary metering label `prefetch` to billing exports (ETA: 1 day)
- open a small runtime change to dedupe prefetch by prefix-slot (design doc coming)

tara: I'll draft a console UI change to show `prefetch_tokens` vs `served_tokens` in the usage breakdown (ETA: 2 sprints).

sam: I'll coordinate credit once BILL-907 has the numbers and legal signoff (ETA: same day if numbers small).

olivia: Thanks all. Jordan — I'll keep you looped. If you can capture a small sample trace with `REDWOOD_DEBUG_PREFETCH=1` it would help us verify internal ids. Example: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
     -H "X-Debug-Prefetch: 1" \
     -d '{"input": "hello"}' \
     https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

jordan: Will do and send trace dump. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

mike: one more note for the docs — call out that 1) prefetch is billable, 2) may lead to invoice > served in dashboard when enabled, 3) we recommend a small TTL and a capped slot multiplier for public docs.

billing-bot: BILL-907 status updated: awaiting metering breakdown (assigned to mike).
